title: Three wall-clock-dependent tests stopped four scheduled refreshes
detail: Runs 40028653350, 40037957529, 40048429858 and 40063011446 failed before Hotspawn collection when a fixed 2026-10-23T09:23:57Z test fixture aged beyond the publisher's correct 12-hour freshness guard. The tests now inject a deterministic evaluation time; the production guard is unchanged and its stale-refusal regression still passes. The last-verified republish job kept the prior site available, but currentness remains blocked until a fresh post-fix publisher run succeeds.

title: The executive summary rendered the dated research anchor twice
detail: Both the compact unresolved register and summary() appended no_line_research_block, producing two id=no-line-research elements on the published homepage and making anchor navigation ambiguous. Final integration retains BE-3's single-owner implementation: the compact register renders the executive-summary copy, summary() does not append another, and /unresolved/ retains its own full-register copy. The link validator rejects duplicate IDs globally. No match, pick, probability or source changed. Pre-build regressions and a 320/390 px every-row browser test require unique IDs and one research block per page.

title: Fixed: combined phone safety labels confused the independent row parser
detail: The phone-first complete-picks overview keeps current and historical status markers in the DOM and hides the inapplicable one. The existing offline row parser consumed only one marker, so a historical row could be read as pick 'Snapshot: TEAM' instead of TEAM. The parser now consumes all status markers before capturing the unchanged team. This was found only on the combined tree; 68 targeted unit tests and 12 phone/browser tests pass afterward. No probability, pick, fixture, presentation label or source was changed by the parser repair.
